segments.title: Pepito Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on, announces Grunchmas Friday brunch, and jokes about executive orders rescheduling days of the week.

segments.title: News Desk Opening & Hype Train Emergence
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast solo, discusses holiday plans and hair, then Hype Train materializes to freestyle about cloacas and cocaine excrement.

segments.title: Hype Train Cloaca Freestyle & Sub Acknowledgements
segments.notes: Hype Train derails into a surreal rap about cloacas as 'breasts of the neck,' train excrement as cocaine, and processes subscriber bits while Case tries to move to news.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple Reports: Trump Cloacas & Rob Reiner Death
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins; they debate terminology for Trump's Truth Social posts (settling on 'cloacas'), cover Rob Reiner's alleged murder by his son, and read Trump's vindictive statement.

segments.title: Live Reaction: Trump Addresses the Nation
segments.notes: Case and Jeff watch Trump's live speech covering $18T investment claims, tariffs, gas prices, housing reform, border invasion rhetoric, and job creation numbers.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Blood Patio, Holes Debate & Pastor Meltdown
segments.notes: Rick (as 'Clementine'/'Big Cheddar') hosts viewer submissions: a bloody patio cleanup, a 'liking holes' debate, a bird video, a pig-dog encounter, and a 16-year-old tech reviewer blowup.

segments.title: Therapy: Dr. Chath's 'Exclamation Point H' Technique
segments.notes: Dr. Chath debuts a new therapeutic method triggered by '!h'; Case endures insults, AI diplomas, and questions about girth, JD Vance comparisons, and Crum. Kendall calls in with a toe-hole concern.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Alien Popcorn Throats & Melania Trailer
segments.notes: Trailer reviews include a popcorn-throated alien horror, a Melania Trump documentary teased as 'prostitute to prostitute,' and an orca thriller compared to 'black Jaws.'

segments.title: DJ C4 Song Production: 'What Do I Even Do Here' for Jan the Intern
segments.notes: Case and DJ C4 compose a hyper-pop track for intern Jan using viewer lyrics; Kendall and ghost-Kendall provide vocals; chorus centers on 'I'm an intern bitch.'

segments.title: Wrap-Up: Grunchmas Friday & Raid
segments.notes: Case confirms Grunchmas Friday at 3 PM, notes unpaid 'Circle the Crunch' debt for Jan, and raids Danny.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the full broadcast: news desk, Trump speech reaction, Amongst the Web co-host, therapy patient, and song producer.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold-open station sign-on and announced Grunchmas Friday brunch plans.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derailed the early broadcast with a surreal cloaca-themed freestyle rap and processed subscriber bits while claiming to excrete cocaine.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: host of Amongst the Web. Hosted Amongst the Web as 'Clementine'/'Big Cheddar,' rating viewer submissions including a bloody patio, holes discourse, and a 16-year-old tech drama.

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Conducted a therapy session using new '!h' technique, insulted Case, revealed AI-generated diplomas, and probed Case's coworkers as fractured personality aspects.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Called into therapy with a 'hole as big toe' concern, then returned as ghost-Kendall to record vocals for the hyper-pop intern song.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: musical producer. Produced the hyper-pop track 'What Do I Even Do Here' for intern Jan, sourcing a Charli XCX instrumental and directing vocal takes.

storylines.beat: [47:22] Case acknowledges the Beyblade competition is still pending: 'We still have to do the Beyblade competition thing. Currently the sub stuff is disabled. I'm rebuilding it.'
[02:22:27] Case confirms Grunchmas Friday stream targeting 3 PM start, with assets ready and a populated thread at cream.team.

lore_notes.fact: Face remains 'lightly blue' and claims to slip in and out of reality when Case fails to sustain hype; consumes hype and excretes cocaine from smokestack.
Hair described as 'in a special state' and progressively crazier throughout stream.
Therapy diplomas are AI-generated gibberish; new technique triggered by chat command '!h'.
Has a 'hole as my big toe' (mole-like) preventing open-toe shoes; appears as 'ghost Kendall' during song production.
Subject of commissioned hyper-pop song 'What Do I Even Do Here'; described as 'lovely young lady with curly hair.'
Unpaid debt: Jan was requested for 'Circle the Crunch' but never delivered.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a chaotic Monday broadcast featuring Hype Train's cloaca-obsessed freestyle, Jeff Ripple's coverage of Trump's vindictive Rob Reiner statement and a live presidential address reaction, Rick's Amongst the Web video reviews, a surreal Dr. Chath therapy session with Kendall's toe-hole revelation, and an extended DJ C4 song-production block crafting a hyper-pop anthem for intern Jan. The episode closes with Grunchmas Friday confirmed for 3 PM and a raid on Danny.
